newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Repsol seen in line with market.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Repsol seen in line with market.

text.p: Traders expect Repsol shares to move in line with the market on Tuesday with no additional selling pressure after the privatisation of the government's last 10.0 percent stake in the firm.
Analysts said that given the prices set for the retail and institutional tranches, at 5,803 pesetas and 6,010 pesetas respectively, there was no point in investors selling stock right away.
"The spread between the placement price and the traded price today is not so attractive that it would justify an avalanche of paper in the market," one trader said.
At 0920 GMT Repsol shares were flat at 6,010 pesetas, while the Ibex-35 blue chip index was up 0.27 percent to 5,772.66.
"The placement price is good, the shares allotted (to each retail investor) are few, as expected," said an ABN-Amro analyst Madrid.
